properties.name: An agent can put its own question to the owner, about the nodes it concerns, without a gap behind it
properties.statement:
An agent can record a Question that no detected gap raised, addressed to a named person and linked to the nodes it is about. open_questions and loop_status then count it and list it like any other waiting question, and answering it records who answered.

From the primes trial, item 6 (F9, F10, F11). @ajs, 2026-10-17.
